event: Vermont Green FC defeated Flint City Bucks 2-1 in the 2026 USL League Two National Final, winning back-to-back championships and extending their unbeaten run to 42 matches.
Flint City Bucks lost 1-2 to Vermont Green FC in the 2026 USL League Two National Final, finishing as national runners-up.
Vermont Green FC completed the 2026 USL2 season with an 18W-1D-0L record, scoring 85 goals, becoming the first club to repeat as USL2 champions in the modern era.
Deportivo Rose City won the UPSL West Regional Final and advanced to the 2026 UPSL Spring National Finals (Aug 7-9, Los Angeles).
New York Renegades FC won the UPSL East Regional Final over Detroit City FC II (3-1) and advanced to the 2026 UPSL Spring National Finals.
Miami United FC advanced to the 2026 UPSL Spring National Finals (Aug 7-9, Los Angeles) as a regional champion.
Central Kansas United advanced to the 2026 UPSL Spring National Finals (Aug 7-9, Los Angeles) as a regional champion.
As a UPSL National Finals participant, Deportivo Rose City is eligible to earn direct 2027 U.S. Open Cup Tournament Proper entry if they finish first or second in Los Angeles.
As a UPSL National Finals participant, New York Renegades FC is eligible to earn direct 2027 U.S. Open Cup Tournament Proper entry if they finish first or second in Los Angeles.

Sacramento Republic FC and Wilton Rancheria announced Republic Stadium at The Railyards will forgo original phased expansion plans, marking a strategic shift in the club's stadium development trajectory.
Sacramento Republic FC leads all USL Championship clubs in average home attendance at 9,743 per match for the 2026 season.
San Antonio FC lead the USL Championship Western Conference through 12 matches with 5 wins, 1 loss, 6 draws and 21 points.
Corpus Christi FC remain winless through at least 10 League One matches, the longest winless run in the division in 2026.
Charlotte Independence defeated Corpus Christi FC 2-1, extending their winning run to at least four consecutive matches.
Chattanooga Red Wolves SC defeated Westchester SC 2-0, continuing their strong domestic form in the 2026 League One season.
Westchester SC fell 0-2 to Chattanooga Red Wolves SC, extending their losing run to at least four consecutive matches in 2026.
Fort Wayne FC hold the longest active unbeaten run in USL League One 2026, going at least seven matches without a loss as of the most recent confirmed data.
Athletic Club Boise leads USL League One in total season attendance with a 7,208 average and a season high of 7,227 for the May 2 match vs. Chattanooga.
Sporting Cascades FC joined USL League One for 2026 as a newly formed professional side replacing the disbanded Lane United FC in the Pacific Northwest.
